reviews.text: It’s Meh, and definitely not worth the money.. The hope was to unblur some older photos and even a couple of very recent ones that had some fuzziness. At first glance, it works well, but if you zoom in at all, you’ll see the app isn’t actually adding more pixels to your photo. It’s using an AI scan to approximate what the subject looks like and then replacing or overlaying the AI image with the original. It has a particularly hard time with glasses, eyes, the mouth, and teeth. In some cases, the image that results is noticeably NOT the person in the photo. The AI will literally change prominent features producing a different person. If you zoom in at all, it shatters the illusion that the image was actually repixelated and unblurred. I would recommend saving your money and not purchasing the app.
